findings.current: I was certain a disaster worse than anything we’d seen would follow.
findings.defect: The source says the coming disaster would be worse than the present situation, not worse than anything humanity had ever seen. The English broadens the comparison.
findings.rationale: “지금보다 더한 재앙” means a disaster worse than now.
findings.replacement: I was certain a disaster worse than the one unfolding now would follow.

findings.current: Explosions erupted everywhere, but the Trolls’ tough skin and tremendous Regeneration kept them standing.
findings.defect: The source says the Trolls’ tough skin and Regeneration were unaffected by the explosions. “Kept them standing” changes that physical detail to whether they remained upright.
findings.rationale: “끄떡도 하지 않았다” says the explosions had no effect on their tough skin and Regeneration.
findings.replacement: Explosions erupted everywhere, but the Trolls’ tough skin and tremendous Regeneration weren’t fazed.

summary: Mostly faithful; two lines shift the source’s meaning or physical detail.
